title: WNBA, union reach verbal agreement for new CBA
summary: After a prolonged labor battle, the WNBA and players' union reached a verbal agreement on the terms for a new collective bargaining agreement early Wednesday.
contentText: After a prolonged labor battle, the WNBA and players' union have reached a verbal agreement on the terms for a new CBA. Sources told ESPN that the salary cap will start at $7 million and raise the average salary to around $600,000.
